webhooks.title: Provider webhooks
webhooks.description: Events of the installation, not of a tenant, for your billing and PSA tools: first billing.period_closed, as soon as a month is closed. Every delivery is signed with the webhook's signing secret (X-Restow-Signature) and carries no tenant's figures, only the link where the tool reads the month.
webhooks.caption: Provider webhooks

empty.title: No webhook yet
empty.description: Add a webhook so your billing tool learns about the monthly close.

webhooks.loadError: The provider webhooks could not be loaded.

form.title: Add a provider webhook
form.description: The webhook gets every event of the provider. You see the signing secret once, right after adding it.
form.name: Name (optional)
form.urlHint: An https address of your tool, without credentials in the URL.

webhooks.createFailed: The webhook could not be added.
webhooks.testFailed: The test delivery could not be queued.
webhooks.toggleFailed: The webhook could not be changed.

rotateDialog.title: Renew the signing secret?
rotateDialog.description: The old secret stops working at once. Store the new one in your tool, or it refuses the deliveries.

deleteDialog.title: Delete the webhook?
deleteDialog.description: The webhook and its pending deliveries are deleted. Your tool no longer learns about the monthly close.
